subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

It was being suggested by multiple sources that the operation had been compromised internally.

options.text: Multiple sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised internally.
The operation was compromised, multiple sources suggested.
The sources were suggesting an operation compromise.
The operation had compromised multiple internal sources.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the passive voice, the focus is on the action and the receiver of the action, rather than the doer.
 
• Original passive sentence: "It was being suggested by multiple sources that the operation had been compromised internally."
 
• To convert to active voice, make "multiple sources" the subject performing the action.
 
• Use the correct tense: "were suggesting" (past continuous).
 
• Keep the rest of the sentence the same to preserve the original meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Multiple sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised internally."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The operation was compromised, multiple sources suggested." – Changes the meaning and tense of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "The sources were suggesting an operation compromise." – Alters the structure and meaning.
 
• **Option 4:** "The operation had compromised multiple internal sources." – Reverses the subject and object, changing the meaning entirely.
